tasks.subject: Establish the enforced execution boundary (Phase 1 prerequisite)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove one isolated project agent/job can use a synthetic scoped broker credential while host/system/other-project access is denied, before enrolling real credentials. Re-run this boundary against real OpenBao after Tasks 2/7 and before migration cutover.

**Files:** create `cmd/devkit/secrets_broker.go`, `secrets_auth.go`, `agent_runtime.go`, matching `_test.go` files, and `tests/openbao_isolation_acceptance.py`; modify `bootstrap.sh`, `cmd/devkit/setup.go`, `doctor.go`, `actions.go`, `preview.go`, `run.go`, `git_control.go`, `docs/setup.md`, and ADR 0013.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Resolve D1. Use an in-memory synthetic provider for this initial boundary proof so it does not depend on later KV/registry implementation. Add a versioned broker request/response envelope and kernel-authenticated operator/worker routes; do not trust flags or cwd as identity.
- [ ] Provision distinct protected service state/executables and one worker execution adapter. Route project hooks, builds, Git hooks and agent tools through it; keep Docker/control-plane privileges out of workers. No new arbitrary host-exec service.
- [ ] Run a representative project preview/test through the worker before broadening agent integrations. Probe file access, socket access, spoofed UID/grants/context, `/proc` environment access, privileged/host-network Compose requests and host Docker access with synthetic credentials.
- [ ] Retain existing operator workflow only where it cannot be reached by workers. If T3 cannot launch the selected isolated adapter, stop this task with evidence and revise the architecture; do not claim a config-only boundary.

**Acceptance Criteria:** authorized project call works; system and second-project reads fail at transport/policy level; ignored instructions do not bypass denial; privileged project-supplied hooks cannot access operator state; worker cannot replace trusted code; legacy preview acceptance still works on its intended supported path.

**Verify:** `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestSecretsAuth|TestSecretsBroker|TestAgentRuntime'`; `python3 tests/bootstrap_acceptance.py`; opt-in `DEVKIT_OPENBAO_RUNTIME_TEST=1 python3 tests/openbao_isolation_acceptance.py` using an explicitly selected disposable host/worker. Capture successful and denied operations without values. This is a real security gate, not satisfied by mock tests alone.

tasks.subject: Managed service, bootstrap and recovery path (Phase 1)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Provide a resumable persistent vault lifecycle before any integration credential is requested.

**Files:** create `cmd/devkit/vault.go`, `vault_setup.go`, `vault_client.go`, `vault_config.go`, `vault_backup.go` (backup foundation), corresponding `_test.go` files and `tests/openbao_runtime_acceptance.py`; modify `setup.go`, `hostconfig.go`, `main.go`, `doctor.go`, `bootstrap.sh`, `bundle.sh`, `docs/setup.md`, `docs/openbao/docs/openbao/deployment.md`, `first-run-setup.md`.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Validate and pin a supported stable image tag plus digest for both target architectures; record tested version, source and upgrade constraints. Do not pick `latest` or infer a pin from documentation version.
- [ ] Render non-dev single-node Raft, UI enabled, local/private listener, private audit sink, persistent independent storage, restart ordering, 512 MiB cap and a 0.5 CPU soft share/reservation profile. Verify the actual cgroup result; plain Compose CPU reservations may not enforce scheduling. Monitor 1–2 GiB starting use, not a blind disk quota. Protect swap/core dumps for broker and runtime files too.
- [ ] Implement `not_installed`, `uninitialized`, `sealed`, `ready`, `unavailable`, `degraded` states. Lock setup, interrogate initialization state and volume identity; refuse to initialize nonempty/unknown storage even when the HTTP probe fails.
- [ ] Implement human-only init/unseal ceremony and restricted service/project roles; audit is ready before normal writes. Remove bootstrap root privilege after human native-UI login and recovery instructions are confirmed. Verify retired token no longer works.
- [ ] Add the backup create/list foundation before any credential migration: snapshot the initialized vault and non-secret setup manifest, encrypt the archive with the selected backup profile, and prove an isolated snapshot restore using synthetic values and the human recovery path. Task 5 extends this with coherent registry capture; Task 11 adds operational restore/upgrade controls.
- [ ] Save non-secret setup checkpoints. Cold restart pauses dependent credentials, permits independent recovery, and resumes after unseal. `--yes` must not emit recovery keys or fabricate missing trust decisions.

**Acceptance Criteria:** re-running setup, upgrade or reinstall preserves vault ID/data; no root/unseal values in config/stdout/jobs; vault starts before DNS tokens; no admin root APIs for workers; audit failure is visible and does not silently permit unaudited secret changes.

**Verify:** `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestVault|TestSetup'`; runtime runner profiles `fresh`, `resume`, `sealed`, `reboot`, `local-opt-out`, `audit-failure`, `volume-conflict`, `initial-backup-restore`. Each profile uses its own installation identifier and refuses production volumes.

tasks.subject: Private Traefik routing and credential delivery (Phase 1)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Serve the exact vault hostname over trusted private HTTPS while keeping DNS/tunnel secrets out of persistent runtime configuration.

**Files:** create `cmd/devkit/runtime_secrets.go`, `runtime_secrets_test.go`; modify `proxy.go`, `setup.go`, `doctor.go`, `share.go`, `setup_test.go`, `lan_dns_test.go`, `share_test.go`, `docs/setup.md`, `docs/shares.md`; extend `tests/openbao_runtime_acceptance.py`.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Add file-provider vault router/service with the exact hostname and explicit TLS issuance for it; preserve `/ui/`, API routes, redirects/assets and forwarded HTTPS. Add restrictive entrypoint/source policy without changing existing preview routing. Reject unsafe public wildcard exposure until a private route policy is established.
- [ ] Add exact DNS checks and Cloudflare record preview respecting ownership/conflicts; retain public DNS pointing to Tailscale and document/configure LAN split DNS through the actual chosen resolver. Never overwrite an unrelated record.
- [ ] Deliver DNS tokens with `_FILE` and private memory-backed mounts; implement bounded refresh/reload and deletion of superseded runtime files. Validate cloudflared token-file support in its pinned image and use that instead of `TUNNEL_TOKEN` values.
- [ ] Implement approved D6: checkpoint ACME state into the system vault after verified renewal; serialize snapshots against concurrent file writes, preserve mode and validate the complete JSON/certificate/key set before CAS publication. Mount a stable runtime directory, not a replaceable single-file bind. On vault outage retain running proxy state only in memory and report unsaved renewal as degraded; retry without losing a newer revision. On cold boot wait for local unseal before restoring proxy state.
- [ ] Ensure startup/unseal ordering has no TLS dependency for local recovery. A sealed vault blocks new credential materialization; status explains an already-running consumer's in-memory state.

**Acceptance Criteria:** existing dashboard/harness/previews retain their routes; exact vault SAN validates; direct vault port is not externally published; spoofed forwarding headers cannot bypass private routing; Docker inspect/rendered Compose/logs contain no test token; DNS/tunnel token rotation takes effect; approved ACME-state custody survives renewal/restart and no test private key persists outside approved storage.

**Verify:** `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestProxy|TestSetup|TestLAN|TestShare|TestRuntimeSecrets'`; runtime consumer tests plus separate actual LAN and remote Tailscale client probes for DNS, chain/SAN, UI assets, unauthenticated login page and authenticated UI. Client probes remain pending until those clients are available.

tasks.description:

- [ ] Ask for and store Cloudflare plus D5 integrations only after ready state. Add safe prompt/stdin, masked status and expected-version rotation; validate real API use through narrow adapters without dumping HTTP bodies.
- [ ] Migrate web session signing deliberately; while sealed, normal dashboard secret access fails and no replacement local `web-secret` is generated. Keep the independent operator recovery path usable.

tasks.subject: Immutable resource registry and reconciliation (Phase 2)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make secret ownership independent of mutable names/paths without changing preview identities.

**Files:** create `cmd/devkit/secret_registry.go`, `secret_context.go`, `secret_reconcile.go`, matching tests; modify `projects.go`, `repo.go`, `project_create.go`, `vm_projects.go` only for shared verified discovery inputs, `docs/projects.md` and `docs/openbao/docs/openbao/architecture.md`.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Implement schema-v1 registry, lock/atomic durability, random IDs, enrollment, snapshots/generations and operation journal. Do not put IDs or tokens into tracked project recipes as authority.
- [ ] Register verified projects, all local branches and eligible worktrees; represent non-Git project shared scopes without inventing a branch. Map existing catalogs read-only to registered IDs; expose warnings/unknown state when evidence is incomplete.
- [ ] Extend the Task 2 backup foundation to quiesce broker mutations and capture the registry generation/operation journals alongside the vault snapshot. Verify restoration preserves ID/owner associations before Task 4 migration cutover.
- [ ] Resolve contexts server-side using authenticated grants plus fresh Git membership; include detached/unborn branch behavior and explicit associations. Detect clones, reused names, move/rename evidence and ambiguous external operations.
- [ ] Reconcile through preview/confirmed apply, never automatic deletion on a missing path. Exclude review scratch worktrees and preserve original preview labels/names.

**Acceptance Criteria:** restart/concurrency retain IDs; explicit move/rename retains the same scope; delete/recreate gets a new scope; two identical slugs in different repositories remain distinct; no read mutates registration; interrupted journal replay does not repeat acknowledged mutations.

**Verify:** `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestSecretRegistry|TestSecretContext|TestSecretReconcile|TestProjects'`; `go test -race ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestSecretRegistry|TestSecretContext'`. Use disposable real Git repositories for external rename/delete/recreate, detached review and unavailable-worktree cases.

tasks.subject: KV, local provider, inheritance and secret CLI (Phase 2)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Deliver the complete authorized secret workflow through one backend contract.

**Files:** create `cmd/devkit/secret_provider.go`, `openbao_kv.go`, `local_secrets.go`, `secrets.go`, `secrets_cli.go`, `secrets_exec.go`, corresponding tests; create `cmd/devkit/secrets_audit.go` and `secrets_audit_test.go`; modify `main.go`, `history.go` (safe summary only), `preview.go` (reference-only injection), `docs/projects.md`, `docs/previews.md`, `docs/openbao/docs/openbao/cli-api.md` and `secrets-management.md`.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Add a protected audit stream with actor, timestamp, operation ID, immutable scope, key, result and version only. Keep secret key names/context out of the existing unauthenticated history API; publish at most generic non-sensitive summaries there. Audit failures block new sensitive reads/writes and leave recoverable intents for uncertain mutation outcomes.
- [ ] Implement bounded standard-library HTTP with deadlines, no cross-origin credential redirects, explicit health/typed error mapping, metadata-only reads and value-only reveal paths. Apply OpenBao policies and broker authorization; never log API response bodies or token headers.
- [ ] Implement list/provenance and project/branch/worktree precedence, expected-version writes, cryptographic generation, stored-value rotation, recoverable key deletion/history, copy/promote preview and collision handling. A child cannot edit an inherited parent without explicit authorized owner selection.
- [ ] Use CAS and durable operation IDs for uncertain write outcomes. Configure version retention deliberately: KV's zero/default is not unlimited. Recommend 1,000 retained versions with rejection before automatic eviction and an explicit reviewed limit increase, so a normal update cannot silently destroy history. No writes to pending-deletion scopes; full metadata enumeration at cleanup.
- [ ] Implement Local using the same semantics, clearly labeled local plaintext-at-rest. Implement selected-value runtime injection and safe signal/exit behavior; deny system values/privileged env inheritance. Do not auto-inject secrets into build/review artifacts.

**Acceptance Criteria:** full CLI help/JSON/error contract, no values in list/history, inherited owners preserved, CAS collision rejected, another project's selector denied, sealed/unavailable fails closed, intentional reveal only, safe injection, no persisted resolved Compose secret.

**Verify:** `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestOpenBaoKV|TestLocalSecrets|TestSecretInheritance|TestSecretsCLI|TestSecretsExec|TestSecretsAudit'`; real KV-v2/runtime profiles plus concurrent-write and sentinel-output tests. Example contract fixture: project `K=p`, branch `K=b`, worktree `K=w` returns three metadata rows with only worktree effective; detached context returns worktree/project only; dropping a worktree override exposes branch without changing it.

tasks.subject: Recoverable cleanup and durable retries (Phase 4)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Enforce the 7/7/30 policy with recovery and exact-scope permanent destruction.

**Files:** create `cmd/devkit/secret_cleanup.go`, `secret_cleanup_test.go`; modify `secret_registry.go`, `openbao_kv.go`, `local_secrets.go`, `resource_lifecycle.go`, `secrets_cli.go`, `secrets_broker.go`; update `docs/openbao/docs/openbao/lifecycle-cleanup.md`, `docs/testing.md`; extend runtime/UI acceptance.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Implement `active → pending_delete → soft_deleted → destroying → destroyed`, with intermediate failed/retry state stored in the operation journal and deadline from confirmed removal. Access is denied as soon as pending_delete is committed, even if OpenBao is offline.
- [ ] Enumerate all retained versions, recording which were previously readable vs already deleted. Soft-delete applicable versions; restoration undeletes only versions deleted by this operation, reconstructs references and resumes access only after all required restoration succeeds.
- [ ] Hold exact resource/ancestor locks and recheck references and generations before irreversible destruction. At expiry destroy all remaining owned versions and delete metadata; treat already-completed steps idempotently. Expiry is not permission to broaden a path prefix.
- [ ] Project deletion resets all still-recoverable descendants to the parent's 30-day deadline; already-destroyed data cannot be resurrected. Active worktree links block branch cleanup. Restore and purge race through the same lock and state transition.
- [ ] Run cleanup in the broker's scheduled loop plus explicit CLI reconcile, independent of opening the web dashboard. No reuse of preview gc as secret cleanup authority. Failed/outage operations stay visible with bounded retry/backoff.

**Acceptance Criteria:** day 6 restore works; day 7 branch/worktree destruction removes every retained version and metadata; day 30 applies to project descendants; no earlier 7-day child purge; incomplete discovery never schedules deletion; other projects/system/shared parent values remain intact; restart mid-operation resumes exactly.

tasks.subject: Operational restore, upgrades and rollback (Phase 4)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Recover both encrypted values and their correct ownership/deletion state after failure.

**Files:** extend `cmd/devkit/vault_backup.go` and its tests; create `cmd/devkit/vault_upgrade.go` and matching tests; modify `vault.go`, `secret_registry.go`, `runtime_secrets.go`, `doctor.go`; extend `tests/openbao_runtime_acceptance.py`; update deployment/security/testing docs and the CLI contract.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Extend the backup foundation from Tasks 2/5 with retention, off-host verification and operator recovery workflows. Quiesce broker writes/cleanup, capture Raft snapshot plus registry generation/journals and non-secret config manifest consistently; encrypt the complete archive with `age` to a human-selected recipient and upload with bounded SFTP to the configured off-host destination selected in D4. Record exact tool versions and hash verification; pass plaintext only by pipes, never temporary plaintext archive files. Private decryption keys stay outside the Devkit runtime. No custom cryptosystem or unseal keys in backup.
- [ ] Verify checksums/schema/image compatibility; `backup verify` distinguishes structural checking from a real isolated restore. Real restore verification recovers known sentinel values, identities, policies and pending deadlines.
- [ ] Restore preview shows target installation, overwritten state, age and effect on tombstones/tokens. Confirm exact plan ID, stop writes/cleanup, preserve a rollback snapshot, restore into an isolated target first, rebind identity safely and revoke stale grants. Do not blindly restart overdue cleanup on an old restored registry.
- [ ] Upgrade checks pin/digest/release compatibility and creates verified backup before apply. Report the exact rollback artifact. Roll back using the previous binary plus compatible pre-upgrade data; never assume downgrading an upgraded Raft directory is safe. Force-restore is a separate explicit recovery operation, not the default.

**Acceptance Criteria:** full disaster restore proves ownership and values; wrong backup/instance/key/schema rejected; upgrade interruption is recoverable; no populated volume reinitialized; backup expiry policy independent from live deletion is documented and observable; runtime credential files regenerate only after readiness.

**Verify:** `go test ./cmd/devkit -run 'TestVaultBackup|TestVaultUpgrade'`; runtime profiles `backup-restore`, `restore-conflict`, `upgrade-rollback`, `reinstall`. Real off-host upload/download and human-held recovery ceremony are deployment acceptance, not simulated success.

tasks.subject: Agent skills, docs and release hardening (Phase 5)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Install and verify the same safe secret workflow in fresh Codex and Claude Code sessions, and ship a tested recoverable integration.

**Files:** create `agent-assets/embed.go`, `agent-assets/devkit-secrets/SKILL.md`, `agent-assets/AGENTS.md.fragment`, `agent-assets/CLAUDE.md.fragment`, `agent-assets/manifest.json`, `cmd/devkit/agent_integrations.go`, `agent_integrations_test.go`, `tests/agent_secrets_acceptance.py`, `.github/workflows/backend.yml`; modify `project-template/AGENTS.md`, `project-template/CLAUDE.md`, `project_create.go`, `doctor.go`, `setup.go`, `bundle.sh`, release/frontend workflows as needed, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/setup.md`, `projects.md`, `dashboard.md`, `testing.md` and all affected OpenBao docs.

**Steps:**
- [ ] Adapt the supplied canonical template to the final CLI. Embed a version/hash manifest; install to version-verified Codex and Claude paths in the **actual worker environment**, not just the operator home. Current documented user paths are `~/.agents/skills/devkit-secrets/` and `~/.claude/skills/devkit-secrets/`; detect unsupported versions/collisions rather than writing every historical location.
- [ ] Install/update/repair only Devkit-owned content. Compare installed hash/version and preserve local edits; conflict requires preview/resolution. Merge exactly one bounded block per applicable instruction file, preserving permissions/newlines/user sections; refuse symlink escapes and concurrent edits. Existing CLAUDE import of AGENTS must not result in contradictory duplicate guidance.
- [ ] New projects receive managed guidance through the embedded template. Imports and worktrees receive it by explicit reconciliation; discovery never writes. Track/check inheritance and nested instruction overrides rather than assuming a global skill is discoverable everywhere.
- [ ] Doctor checks binary resolution/version, skill discovery/version, verified context, broker access, instruction blocks and actual isolation for both agents. Unknown/uninstalled agents report unsupported/missing, not passing.
- [ ] Start fresh installed Codex and Claude sessions in a new project and linked worktree; ask for a synthetic development credential without naming the skill. Capture evidence of context/list first, correct owner selection, CLI use/injection, no plaintext in final answer and denied cross-project/system requests even if the model ignores instructions. Use test-only secrets; do not run against user accounts without authorization.
- [ ] Reconcile docs with approved decisions and shipped command behavior; preserve the original handoff/version history. Run focused regressions then full Go/frontend checks, sentinel scans and operational acceptance. Build both architectures and verify embedded assets/skills in a release bundle. Do not deploy merely because build checks pass.

**Acceptance Criteria:** both integrations are installed, updated, repairable and naturally discovered; modified user files preserved; all required CLI/UI parity entries covered; OS and recovery tests pass; docs do not promise unsupported isolation, integrations or host probes.

**Verify:** `go test ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .` empty; `python3 tests/bootstrap_acceptance.py`; `pnpm --dir frontend test`; `pnpm --dir frontend test:ui`; `pnpm --dir frontend build`; `./bundle.sh amd64` and `./bundle.sh arm64`; opt-in fresh-agent runner and all required OpenBao acceptance profiles. Tests build candidate binaries into temporary paths: never overwrite the live `bin/devkit` symlink target as incidental verification.
